This observation describes the full product architecture for monetising the fatbaby pipeline via a tiered "Ask Emily" product, community-driven editorial engine, and Merkle-backed query deduplication. This is a synthesis of a design session and should be implemented as a coherent feature set.

## GTM Funnel — Three Layers

### Layer 1 — Free (Top of Funnel): The Newssite
The newssite at :8082 is the open-access front door. No login required. It publishes:
- Raw SEC filings and press releases (existing)
- Emily-authored governance commentary articles (see previous observation re: ingest endpoint)
- Auto-generated signal alerts when entity-graph fires high/critical signals
- EPS reconciliation narratives ("LLY beats by $0.12
